title: Director-Managed Chiplet Boundary (UCIe 3.0 Manageability)
boundary_mechanism: UCIe 3.0 manageability: early firmware download, MTP/MCTP-class flows, priority sideband, open-drain throttle/shutdown

unknowns.question: Deployment-level distinct governance (not protocol roles alone)?
Authoritative configuration state after partial download
Version mismatch authority and rejection proof
Director state vs chiplet-local state under disagreement
Proof after failed or interrupted management action

known: Director-mediated first mutable firmware download is specified; satellite chiplet waits
SiP-wide fast throttle and emergency shutdown via open-drain broadcast are specified
Verification literature requires MTP boot, version mismatch, partial transfer, recovery, and security test surfaces
Compliance does not guarantee multi-vendor interoperability
assumed: No unpublished SiP integrator runbook is treated as public evidence
Director role assignment does not alone prove independent governance
evidence_boundary: Public UCIe briefs and verification analysis end before normative deployment authority, recovery ownership, and dual-sided proof contracts
